cites.quote: A past appointment the patient attended, closed by staff once its start time has passed.
An appointment that is booked and still open.
Blood group, allergies, chronic conditions, current medications and notes of one patient.

in the MVP every
user acts as `staff`
starts late in the evening in Asia/Kolkata
The Last visit date is the calendar date in the hospital time zone `Asia/Kolkata`.

findings.suggested_fix: Rephrase AC3 to use a Completed appointment whose start time is between 00:00 and 05:30 Asia/Kolkata, when the UTC date is the previous day. Then check that the IST date is shown.
findings.text: S-1 AC3 tests with a late-evening IST start time. Asia/Kolkata is UTC+05:30, so a late-evening IST time falls on the same UTC date. The IST and UTC dates only differ for start times between 00:00 and 05:30 IST, so this criterion cannot catch the time-zone bug.

cites.quote: Given a patient whose only appointments are Cancelled, No-show or Scheduled
Given a patient with no Completed appointment, when the patient list is shown

findings.suggested_fix: Merge S-1 AC5 into S-2 AC1 as a patient with only Cancelled, No-show or Scheduled appointments who shows '-'. Or reference one criterion from the other.
findings.text: S-1 AC5 (only non-Completed appointments, so no dates are shown) overlaps S-2 AC1 (no Completed appointment, so '-' is shown). The same scenario is tested in two stories, which makes them less independent.

cites.quote: Given a patient with a Scheduled future appointment, when the patient list is shown
The existing `Next` appointment column is unchanged.

findings.suggested_fix: Add a criterion that a patient with no Scheduled future appointment shows the same Next appointment value as before.
findings.text: S-3 AC4 checks that Next appointment is unchanged only for patients with a Scheduled future appointment. Patients with no upcoming appointment are not covered, but REQ-9 requires the whole column to be unchanged.

rubric_items.reason: All 13 known REQs (REQ-1..REQ-13) are traced by at least one story. The intent has no assumed or unknown REQs.
Stories are mostly single-outcome. S-3 bundles five regression constraints into one story, and S-1 AC5 overlaps S-2 AC1.
All criteria are Given/When/Then. But S-1 AC3's 'late in the evening' scenario cannot tell an IST date from a UTC date, so the time-zone check is not effective.
20 per page, Asia/Kolkata and '-' all come from the intent. The 'late in the evening' test time is not sourced and is wrong for the purpose.
Readable and uses glossary statuses consistently. There is minor duplication between S-1 AC5 and S-2 AC1.
